name: Artanrecords Studio
securityNotice: Use your shared Store and Studio identity to sign in or request password recovery. A password change affects both services. Phone verification is not active; no verification text is sent.
summary: The artist platform being developed by Artanrecords for release preparation, agreements and royalty reporting.

visualLayers.notice: Custom visual layers are not connected in Studio yet.

overview.title: Your artist profile starts here
overview.description: Sign in with your shared Artan account and make your artist profile your own. Read the guidance for your next release when you are ready.
overview.statusText: Account access and private artist profiles are connected. Release submissions, streaming reports, contract signing and payouts are not available yet. Creating an account does not approve an artist agreement.

features.title: Artist profile
features.description: Available now: your profile, catalogue metadata and field visibility choices. Creating an account does not approve an artist agreement or publish a profile.

features.title: Release preparation
features.description: Available now: private release and track metadata drafts. Prepared, not active: music submission and delivery. Saving a draft does not release music.

features.title: Agreements and reporting
features.description: Requires activation: agreement access, signing, streaming reports, royalty statements and payouts. No balances or earnings are simulated.
